# Public job-feed adapter provenance

`live-feed.mjs` is copied without changes from the same owner's
`storyshaw2-hue/jobtracker` repository, revision
`972e7c30256976f6b45ee024a9315d63a289cb0e`.

Only this public, read-only employer-feed adapter is imported. No personal tracker
records, SQLite databases, private seed files, resumes, credentials, or research
snapshots are copied. Its configured public employer boards, check-time evidence,
bounded responses, deduplication, stale-state handling, and cache remain intact.

Source: https://github.com/storyshaw2-hue/jobtracker/blob/972e7c30256976f6b45ee024a9315d63a289cb0e/src/live-feed.mjs
